Needs a Heavy Chassis. The driver fires one harpoon as an Action (Heavy Weapons, Shortbow table, vehicles within 25m only): 4d6 melee damage, and a 20 HP cable keeps both vehicles within 25m of each other. The other driver frees it with DV17 on their control Skill, or someone at the harpoon with DV15 Brawling. Reel in to ram: +1 to the Check and +2d6 damage.

Cost / Moto: Moto 5
Fits: All except Bikes, Gyrocopters, and Jetskis
